minimumUsefulScope: Exactly these three native 2K individual requests. Not a 30-request batch, not batch 18, not a rig repurchase, and not Iron melee or Industrial heavy.

estimate.basis: Recorded later-73 gemini-3.1-flash-image native 2K rate: 1680 image tokens at $60 per 1M = $0.1008 image output; average successful generation in that run $0.1036.

requests.consumer: One army unit drawn at about 50px and 64px on the long side.
requests.camera: Three-quarter front, eye-level standing figure, full body inside the frame, both boots clear of the frame edge, weapon readable.
requests.requestText: One Stone Age melee fighter, a single adult standing figure, three-quarter front view. Full body in frame, including both boots and the top of the head. Hold one Stone Age melee weapon in the hands. Fur, leather, hide, and rough stone or bone kit. Neutral standing pose on nothing. No ground, no rocks, no dirt slab, no wooden platform, no plinth, no caption, no border, no second person, no animal, and no text. Isolate the figure for a transparent background.
requests.identity: Stone melee, not bronze, iron, or medieval plate.
requests.matte: Delivered alpha must be checked after return. A model request does not prove transparency. No floor larger than a restrained contact shadow at 64px.
requests.anatomy: Both legs connected. Both boot silhouettes and soles intact. Hands contacting the weapon. No clipped head, weapon tip, or foot.
acceptance: Alpha inspected on white, black, and neutral green (110,132,104)
Both boots and the weapon still present
No diorama, platform, caption, or neighbor
